title: EXCHANGE TRANSFUSION
knowledge: Enumerates the condition that would require an exchange transfusion and rationale for performing the procedure.
State nurse's responsibility prior, during and post exchange transfusion.
Identifies procedural laboratory data needed to be done prior exchange transfusion.
Verbalizes complications that may occur during and post exchange transfusion.
skills: Demonstrates equipment assembly for an exchange transfusion.
Demonstrates documentation of cycles, medications and procedures tolerance.
Demonstrates holistic assessment and care of the patient requiring an exchange transfusion.
Demonstrates safe precautions relating to all aspects of an exchange transfusion.
attitude: Responds to patient's family's questions and concerns regarding exchange transfusion.
Adheres to safety procedures in the performance of exchange transfusion.

title: HAND RUBBING
knowledge: Identify purpose and indications of Hand Rubbing.
Discusses the proper step of Hand Rubbing.
skills: Strict in following the aseptic technique.
Follows the five moments of hand hygiene: a. Before touching the patient, b. Before any procedure c. After touching the patient d. After any procedure e. After touching the patient's surroundings.
Made sure that the fingernails are short and artificial nails, watch, rings are removed.
Applies about 3-5 ml of alcohol gel and spreads over both hands and wrists including between fingers, and under nails.
Vigorously rubs hands together for at least 10 seconds. Cleaning all surfaces including 2 inches above wrist, between fingers and under nails.
Done the procedure for about 20-30 seconds.
Make sure that the hands and wrists are dry.
attitude: Accept constrictive criticism as learning opportunity.
To be self-aware of limitation in knowledge and skills.
Ability to organize and facilitate a Reflection session in and on practice after Hand Rubbing learning opportunity occurs and activates findings to improve future practice and response.
